scripts.build:all: npm run openapi:generate && npm run build:layer && npm run build:lambdas
scripts.deploy:development: npm run build:all && cdk deploy RespondiBeStack-development -c env=development --profile aws-milos-pet-club --region us-east-2 --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:only:development: cdk deploy RespondiBeStack-development -c env=development --profile aws-milos-pet-club --region us-east-2 --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:all && dotenv -e .env.staging -- cdk deploy RespondiBeStack-staging -c env=staging --profile aws-milos-pet-club --region us-east-2 --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:only:staging: dotenv -e .env.staging -- cdk deploy RespondiBeStack-staging -c env=staging --profile aws-milos-pet-club --region us-east-2 --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:all && dotenv -e .env.production -- cdk deploy RespondiBeStack-production -c env=production --profile aws-milos-pet-club --region us-east-2 --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:only:production: dotenv -e .env.production -- cdk deploy RespondiBeStack-production -c env=production --profile aws-milos-pet-club --region us-east-2 --require-approval never
scripts.destroy:development: cdk destroy RespondiBeStack-development -c env=development --profile aws-milos-pet-club --region us-east-2
